Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Mjminker wrote:
> if a minion with true faith is bleeding his/her prey, the prey then trys to
> play deflection or redirection to send the bleed else where, is the minion with

> true faith affected by these reaction cards?

Yes. True Faith protects against actions, not reactions, that require Pre or Dom.
